title: Procedural Native AEGP Cubics to Vector-only SVG pattern
evidence: E2-T compiled x64 independent AEGP loaded via public PICA mock and resulting SVG parsed
E2-X separate prior real AE2026 original/corrected PICA plugin connection
question: Can actual compiled AEGP-native cubic geometry be transformed by code into a procedurally instanced editable vector artifact without a raster stage?
observed_result: VectorBridgeToSVG.exe loads actual VectorBridgeAEGP.aex; generates 28 SVG path elements with 4 cubics each (112 total); no SVG image/foreignObject, finite and in bounds; output differs between t=0 and t=.5.
limits: Not an Adobe-host-native BEE_VectorArt renderer output
SVG import into AE native Shape Layer of this exact sample still untested
No effect-instance-aware geometry or AE renderer dependencies
